thread:
vivian: Heads-up — I'm refreshing the Hello onboarding quickstart to default to OIDC for private/Dedicated setups. Plan: switch examples to REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE, add a small local dev proxy in compose, update SDK snippet for v10, and include a migration checklist. Need a couple quick reviewers.

mark: SG. Will we still show the API_KEY flow?

vivian: Yes — keeping API_KEY in a short appendix for ~10 days with a note about migration.

eli: Can you paste the exact snippet you'll include so I can check copy/paste accuracy?

vivian: Sure — small examples I'll include: 

```
# .env (recommended for private/Dedicated)
REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE=oidc
REDWOOD_OIDC_ISSUER=https://idp.example.com
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=rr-hello-quickstart
# local dev only
REDWOOD_LOCAL_PROXY=true
```

# Python quickstart (SDK v10)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(auth_mode="oidc")
resp = c.generate("Hello from Hello Quickstart")
print(resp.text)
```

vivian: I'll also add a docker-compose.override.yml with a `local-auth-proxy` service that exchanges codes for session tokens so devs don't need a live IdP for the tutorial. Security callout will be prominent: "dev-only, never run in prod".

mark: For CI I'll add a docs smoke job that brings up compose + runs `tests/quickstart_oidc_smoke.py`. I'll wire in the prow secret helper to inject test client creds (no plaintext).

eli: I'll add the smoke test harness and a small healthcheck asserting `/token-exchange` returns 200. Also add a `scripts/dev/seed_oidc_test_secrets.sh` helper for local dev.

vivian: Good. Migration checklist draft I'll add to the PR: 1) create OIDC client in your IdP, 2) add redirect URIs, 3) move client secret to KMS/HSM, 4) update REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE, 5) run smoke tests and monitor token rotation.

qa-bot: Reminder: docs CI requires a smoke label. Please add `---ci:quickstart-oidc` to the PR so the docs pipeline picks up the job.

vivian: Will do. I'll open the PR now and include a one-liner to run the smoke test locally: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker.compose.dev.yml up --build && ./scripts/dev/seed_oidc_test_secrets.sh && ./scripts/dev/run_quickstart_smoke.sh`.

docs-bot: PR opened by vivian: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5105 — quickstart: OIDC default + local-auth-proxy + CI smoke job

mark: Quick nit: in the docs copy please call it "local auth proxy (dev-only)" and avoid "mini-IdP" phrasing. Also link to /private-deploy/auth for Private customers.

vivian: Good catch — will update wording and add the Private Deploy link and a KMS note. Targeting merge tomorrow 10:30 PT after a quick review and green CI.

eli: I'll review shortly. :thumbsup:

mark: LGTM pending CI.
